title: Inactivity period
loadError: The inactivity period could not be loaded.
intro: You are entitled to request a break (in months). During this time you would not take part in the club's activities and would pay a minimum maintenance fee that keeps your place and your current fee for when you return. It can be requested until day {deadlineDay} of the month before the inactivity period starts.
endNote: The end date can be changed during the inactivity period (also until day {deadlineDay}).
